arguments.command:
python -c "
import parse

# Test auto-detection with x format
result = parse.parse('a {:x} b', 'a 0xFF b')
print(f'0xFF -> {result.fixed[0] if result else \"NO MATCH\"}')

result = parse.parse('a {:x} b', 'a FF b')
print(f'FF -> {result.fixed[0] if result else \"NO MATCH\"}')

result = parse.parse('a {:x} b', 'a 123 b')
print(f'123 -> {result.fixed[0] if result else \"NO MATCH\"}')

result = parse.parse('a {:i} b', 'a 0b101 b')
print(f'0b101 with i -> {result.fixed[0] if result else \"NO MATCH\"}')

result = parse.parse('a {:i} b', 'a 0o77 b')
print(f'0o77 with i -> {result.fixed[0] if result else \"NO MATCH\"}')

result = parse.parse('a {:i} b', 'a 0xFF b')
print(f'0xFF with i -> {result.fixed[0] if result else \"NO MATCH\"}')
"
